entity: Los Angeles-area (ZIP 912-916) concentration of newly enrolled home health agencies; 14545 Friar St clustering
what_we_add: The enrollment-vintage split: 35% of post-2019 enrollees in five LA ZIPs vs 3% of pre-2013 enrollees; and the Medicare-enrollment count at Friar St (49 agencies, 9 hospices)
why: Home Health Care News has LA County agencies up 46% 2019-2023 while the nation shrank, MedPAC and the county board flag the same concentration, and NBC LA names 14545 Friar St as a mass-registration address — same finding, same direction. Nobody states the ZIP-level vintage shares; NBC's 197 is state hospice licenses, a different file, so no contradiction.
